trial_title: Long-term Safety Study of Intramuscular Injections of 750 mg and 1000 mg Testosterone Undecanoate in Hypogonadal Men
brief_summary: To evaluate the pharmacokinetics of TU 750 mg and TU 1000 mg via multiple measurements of serum total testosterone.

eligibility_table.criterion: Male with primary or secondary hypogonadism at least 18 years of age and for study part C2 weighs ≥143.3 lb (≥65 kg)
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is 19 years old, which does not meet the minimum age requirement of 18 years for inclusion.

eligibility_table.criterion: Morning screening serum testosterone concentration <300 ng/dL
eligibility_table.justification: The patient's serum testosterone level is 65 ng/dL, which is below the threshold of 300 ng/dL.

eligibility_table.criterion: American Urological Association (AUA) Symptom Score ≥15 or significant prostatic symptoms
eligibility_table.justification: There is no indication of significant prostatic symptoms or an AUA Symptom Score provided, thus assumed to be below 15.

eligibility_table.criterion: History of carcinoma, tumors or induration of the prostate or the male mammary gland including suspicion thereof
eligibility_table.justification: No history of carcinoma, tumors, or induration of the prostate or male mammary gland is reported.

eligibility_table.criterion: Screening serum prostate-specific antigen (PSA) level >4 ng/mL or hyperplasia of the prostate (size >75 cm3 as measured by transrectal ultrasonography)
eligibility_table.justification: No PSA level is provided, but given the patient's age and conditions, it is assumed to be within normal limits.

eligibility_table.criterion: Past or present liver tumors or acute or chronic hepatic disease with impairment of liver function; liver function tests (alanine aminotransferase [ALT], aspartate aminotransferase [AST]) exceeding 1.5 times upper limit of normal
eligibility_table.justification: No history of liver tumors or hepatic disease is reported, and no liver function tests are exceeding normal limits.

eligibility_table.criterion: History of deep vein thrombosis in the past 5 years or any history of cerebrovascular accident
eligibility_table.justification: No history of deep vein thrombosis or cerebrovascular accident is reported.
No mention of severe acne in the patient's profile.

eligibility_table.criterion: Hypertension (systolic blood pressure >160 mm Hg and diastolic blood pressure >95 mm Hg) or coronary heart disease not stabilized by therapy as assessed by the investigator
eligibility_table.justification: No indication of hypertension or coronary heart disease is provided.

eligibility_table.criterion: Insulin-dependent diabetes mellitus or uncontrolled non-insulin-dependent diabetes mellitus; patients with diabetes are excluded if screening glycated hemoglobin (HbA1C) level is >9%
eligibility_table.justification: No indication of diabetes or elevated HbA1C levels is provided.

eligibility_table.criterion: Use of any sex hormones within 28 days (for injectable testosterone preparations) or 7 days (for oral, gel, patch, etc, testosterone preparations) prior to screening visit and throughout the study (exclusive of administered study drug)
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not used any sex hormones within the specified time frame.

eligibility_table.criterion: Use of steroidal anabolic drugs or supplements (eg, dehydroepiandrosterone [DHEA]) by any application method within the 28 days prior to first administration of study drug and throughout the study (exclusive of administrated study drug)
eligibility_table.justification: There is no indication of the use of steroidal anabolic drugs or supplements.

eligibility_table.criterion: Medication with substances which might interfere with testosterone metabolism within 28 days before the first administration of study drug
eligibility_table.justification: No medications that might interfere with testosterone metabolism have been reported.

eligibility_table.criterion: History of sleep apnea Insulin-dependent diabetes mellitus
eligibility_table.justification: The patient does not have a history of sleep apnea or insulin-dependent diabetes mellitus.

eligibility_table.criterion: Use of steroidal anabolic drugs or supplements by any application method within the 28-days prior to the first administration of the study drug and throughout the study (exclusive of the administered study drug)
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not used steroidal anabolic drugs or supplements within the specified time frame.
